blocks.raw: # Card Notifications

blocks.raw: ## CARDAUTH
blocks.text: CARDAUTH

blocks.raw: This sends a webhook notification in the event of:
blocks.text: This sends a webhook notification in the event of:

blocks.raw:
* Approved card Authorisation
* Declined card Authorisation (*Reason* field will specify the decline reason)
* Subsequent Decline of previously Approved Authorisation (This happens in case of the network outage. *Reason* field will include Timeout information and *PreviousActivityStatus* will specify "APPROVED")
* Authorisation Reversal (When the transaction is partially or fully reversed, *OrderId* can be used to link any reversed amount with a previously approved Authorisation)
blocks.text: Approved card AuthorisationDeclined card Authorisation (Reason field will specify the decline reason)Subsequent Decline of previously Approved Authorisation (This happens in case of the network outage. Reason field will include Timeout information and PreviousActivityStatus will specify "APPROVED")Authorisation Reversal (When the transaction is partially or fully reversed, OrderId can be used to link any reversed amount with a previously approved Authorisation)

blocks.raw: ## CARDAUTHOFFLINE
blocks.text: CARDAUTHOFFLINE

blocks.raw: This webhook will send a notification when an offline authorisation or force settlement is made available (usually day before settlement)
blocks.text: This webhook will send a notification when an offline authorisation or force settlement is made available (usually day before settlement)

blocks.raw:
> 🚧
>
> This is a notification only and no value will be passed to the account until the formal transaction is completed during the settlement process, it is only for informational purposes
blocks.text: This is a notification only and no value will be passed to the account until the formal transaction is completed during the settlement process, it is only for informational purposes

blocks.raw: ## Settlements and Refunds
blocks.text: Settlements and Refunds

blocks.raw: When card authorisations settle we will record a transaction against the account, which will trigger [PAYOUT Webhook](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/payout-webhook)
blocks.text: When card authorisations settle we will record a transaction against the account, which will trigger PAYOUT Webhook

blocks.raw: If a transaction has been refunded we will create a credit entry on the account, which will, in turn, trigger the [PAYIN Webhook](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/payin-webhook)
blocks.text: If a transaction has been refunded we will create a credit entry on the account, which will, in turn, trigger the PAYIN Webhook

blocks.raw: Webhooks above are universal and trigger on most payment types (not just cards)
blocks.text: Webhooks above are universal and trigger on most payment types (not just cards)

blocks.raw: ## CARDCREATION
blocks.text: CARDCREATION

blocks.raw: This sends a webhook notification that informs of the outcome of a successfully submitted create physical card request. Possible results are:
blocks.text: This sends a webhook notification that informs of the outcome of a successfully submitted create physical card request. Possible results are:

blocks.raw:
* Error
* Created
blocks.text: ErrorCreated

blocks.raw: This is only supported for Physical Cards.
blocks.text: This is only supported for Physical Cards.

blocks.raw: A successful outcome will provide details of the created card including the card ID, masked PAN and provides the original task ID & external ref for the create request so that the outcome can be reconciled with the request.
blocks.text: A successful outcome will provide details of the created card including the card ID, masked PAN and provides the original task ID & external ref for the create request so that the outcome can be reconciled with the request.

blocks.raw:
> 📘 Webhook retry logic. In case we cannot reach your receiving endpoint, we will retry:
>
> 1st retry - after 1 minute\
> 2nd retry - after 5 minutes\
> 3rd retry - after 25 minutes\
> 4th retry - after 2 hours 5 minutes\
> 5th retry - after 10 hours 25 minutes

blocks.raw: ## CARDSTATUSUPDATE
blocks.text: CARDSTATUSUPDATE

blocks.raw: This sends a webhook notification in the event of a card changing status, regardless of what triggered/performed the status update. This can help clients be informed of card status changes that were not initiated by their API user e.g. card status change performed via the Customer Portal, or a card status initiated by an internal Modulr process e.g. card expiry.
